decision_conditions:
<div style="font-family: " segoe="" ui";="" line-height:="" 20px;"=""><p class="MsoNormal">The
proposed two-storey rear extension, hip-to-gable roof enlargement and rear
dormer extension, by reason of their scale, bulk, massing, design and roof
form, would fail to respect the appearance, form, proportions and character of
the original dwelling. The development would result in an overly dominant and
visually intrusive form of development that would harm the character and
appearance of the host dwelling, the roofscape and the surrounding streetscene.
The proposal therefore fails to achieve high quality design and is contrary to
Policies D12.1, D12.2, D12.3 and D12.4 of the Merton Local Plan (2024).<o:p></o:p></p></div>

<div style="font-family: " segoe="" ui";="" line-height:="" 20px;"=""><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Aptos&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-ascii-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-hansi-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;
mso-bidi-theme-font:minor-bidi;mso-ligatures:standardcontextual;mso-ansi-language:
EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">The proposed
two-storey rear extension, in combination with the hip-to-gable roof
enlargement and rear dormer extension, by reason of its scale, bulk, height,
depth and siting, would result in an unduly dominant and overbearing form of
development that would create unacceptable visual intrusion to Nos.72 &amp; 76 Fleming
Mead and additionally, would result in a loss of outlook and loss of light to
no.72. The proposal would therefore be detrimental to neighbouring residential
amenity and contrary to Policies D12.3 and D12.4 of the Merton Local Plan
(2024).</span></div>
description: APPLICATION FOR A REAR DORMER ROOF EXTENSION, HIP TO GABLE EXTENSION, TWO STOREY REAR EXTENSION, EXTERNAL INSULATION, INSTALLATION OF A FRONT WINDOW AT FIRST FLOOR LEVEL, INSTALLATION OF A FRONT PORCH AND INSTALLATION OF SOLAR PANELS TO FRONT ROOF PITCH AND FLAT DORMER ROOF.
